subject: english
stem: A museum room holds twelve visitors. A school group has ten students and three adults. The rule counts everyone in the room. Can the whole group enter together?
options: No, because adults may never enter
No, the group has thirteen people

optionRationales.reason: No, because adults may never enter：成人可進，只是總數超量。
No, the group has thirteen people：10 加 3 為 13，超過容量 12。
Yes, only students count：規則說 everyone。
Yes, thirteen is under twelve：數值比較錯誤。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「相隔句子分別提供的條件合併後得到唯一答案」可推出 No, the group has thirteen people；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 No, the group has thirteen people 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
